text: Heisenberg（化学家取名就是有范）上线，和 Tuco 交易中，哈哈哈哈 Tuco 的 tight tight tight～很洗脑啊，听说 Tuco 的演员因为扮演 Tuco 太消耗气血了（确实也是，好活力满满的 Tuco Salamanca😼），就要求编剧快点把他写死，哈哈哈哈哈哈
textEn: Heisenberg (a chemist really knows how to pick a cool name) enters the chat and makes a deal with Tuco. Hahahaha, Tuco's ‘tight, tight, tight!’ is ridiculously catchy. I heard playing Tuco drained so much of the actor's life force (honestly, no wonder—Tuco Salamanca is pure chaotic energy 😼) that he asked the writers to kill him off ASAP. Hahahahahaha!

images.alt: 化身 Heisenberg 的老白与杰西拿着交易所得现金
